text:
mike: kicking off schema migration for payments.items during the 02:00-03:00 UTC change window. Plan: ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN (CONCURRENTLY), then trickle backfill, then cutover. pin app version to 2.14.1 for 1h post-cutover. runbook: https://runbooks.internal/rb/mig-3891234567 :spiral_calendar:

deploybot: @mike scheduled migration job 3891234567 for 2024-06-15T02:05Z. Steps: apply-ddl -> canary-backfill -> holdpoint -> promote -> unpin. Will post status updates to this thread.

tara: quick q — what's the trickle rate and chunk size? want to avoid lock spikes.

mike: using --rate=50 rps and chunk_size=1000 rows, pause on lock errors, retry backoff 10s. will enable DB-level deadlock alerts.

chris: can we add a holdpoint after 15m of canary backfill for SRE to validate transaction p99s?

sophia: +1. also recommend route read-replicas to old schema for 30m if we see increased read latency.

jordan: SQL for non-blocking add + batch update:

```
ALTER TABLE payments.items ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS new_status text;
-- backfill in batches
BEGIN;
UPDATE payments.items SET new_status = old_status WHERE id BETWEEN $start AND $end;
COMMIT;
```

Backfill runner: `./backfill_runner --job payments.items --rate=50 --chunk=1000`

deploybot: note: will emit canary metrics to #metrics-ingest and tag with mig=3891234567.

samir: rollback criteria proposal: abort and revert if (a) DB lock errors > 5% for 5m, (b) p99 write latency > 200ms for 5m, or (c) backfill error rate > 0.5%. If triggered, execute escape-hatch: pause backfill, set feature-flag off, and run rollback plan.

mike: adding escape hatch: feature flag `payments_items_v2` toggle + app pin back to 2.13.x. I'll update the runbook section with exact commands.

tara: also add a DB-level safety: limit long-running tx count to 10 and auto-kill if over threshold (ops approved).

sophia: I'm on-call for the window, I'll watch the dashboards. chris and I will be standing by for rollback.

mike: starting DDL on canary cluster now. I'll post progress.

deploybot: DDL applied to canary at 02:07Z. Backfill job started for canary. Job id: backfill-3891234567-canary.

metrics-bot: canary backfill throughput: 45 rps, p99 write latency: 180ms, lock errors: 0.2% (5m).

chris: looks healthy, ramping to 50rps. Holding at +15m for manual check.

mike: holdpoint reached. SRE: can you confirm no regressions on tx latency and errors?

sophia: dashboards look green. no increase in 5xxs, read latency stable. :thumbsup:

deploybot: promoted migration to 10% traffic at 02:25Z. Next step: gradual rollout to 100% with 15m observation windows.

mike: leaving rollout open; reminder: if any rollback criteria hit, we abort and follow rollback checklist in runbook.

samir: acknowledged. I'll be ready to flip feature flag and run the rollback job if needed.

mike: thanks everyone — will post final cutover summary once at 100%.

metrics-bot: canary -> 10%: throughput stable, p99=175ms, lock errors 0.15%.

chris: fine to continue ramp after final check at 40%.

sophia: good to proceed.

mike: cutover completed to 100% at 02:55Z. unpin scheduled at 03:55Z. leaving monitoring on for 60m.

deploybot: migration 3891234567 closed: success. All post-migration checks passed.

mike: adding postmortem notes and release notes to the PR: small window, trickle backfill, no rollback needed. Great job everyone. :tada:
